info.text:
In 2025, 79% of stock-picking pros lost to an index.
Active large-cap US funds that trailed the S&P 500: 85% in 2021, 51% in 2022, 60% in 2023, 65% in 2024, 79% in 2025.
In the first half of 2026, 67% still trailed.
Average 2025 fee on $10,000: about $64 for active stock funds vs $5 for index stock funds.
Sources: S&P Dow Jones Indices SPIVA U.S. Year-End 2025 and Mid-Year 2026, U.S. Persistence Scorecard Year-End 2025; ICI Trends in Expenses and Fees of Funds, 2025.
News and education, not financial advice.
